protocol.starts: Zero; previous greedy result; six Gaussian perturbations of it with sigma 0.3, halved until feasible. All clipped to bounds.
protocol.search: Best-coordinate ascent at both resolutions for each start. Current biases also included as candidates. Select highest validation mIoU; ties prefer higher OA, then smaller squared bias norm, then earlier start.
protocol.caveat: Repeatedly inspected validation and test fold; exploratory. No test scores used in this search. The OA constraint is validation-only.

test_evaluation: Frozen validation-selected settings; no test tuning.
